And every page he looks at is like a new design — it looks sort of like it but not completely like it. And he doesn't think those colors are aligned right — the F and the D, pretty sure F and D have different colors of the same color. And then the cover / no cover / full screen — he doesn't understand that. And this whole page is a Smart Mail — we already have a Smart Mail — so the other Smart Mail actually looks more elegant than this one, in a way. Some of it looks nice, like the icons sure look nice. But he thinks we need to find a happy medium between them, or maybe make the best of the best — he's not sure — but we gotta make it more elegant.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine you have TWO toy mailboxes, and one is prettier in some ways and the other is prettier in other ways! That's silly — why have two? Let's take the very best parts of BOTH and make ONE super mailbox! And the letters F and D have to be the exact same color — not two different shades of the same color! And if a button is confusing, we make it clear or take it away. And flat buttons? No way — buttons have to pop up like real buttons you can press!
